description: Protected ADTS frames at 22050 Hz of ten channel pairs, the first with a wrong CRC and no SBR data and the others followed by an SBR payload: the first frame is no evidence, so the second block decides and the stream is HE-AAC at 44100 Hz.
findings: 1 ADTS frame fails the CRC check
9 of 9 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe_streams: ffmpeg takes implicit SBR from the first block's payload.
skip.decode: ffmpeg does not check ADTS CRCs, and its first block holds no SBR data.
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg does not check ADTS CRCs, and its first block holds no SBR data.
